name: Soko Hotel
description: Soko Hotel is an editorial hospitality WordPress theme designed for a thirty-two room boutique hotel in a restored 1924 brick harbour warehouse on Kessel Quay. Built with classic serif typography, generous letterbox framing, and a quiet documentary aesthetic, it presents rooms, architectural history, dining, and direct reservations with unhurried clarity.

fonts.role: display: headings, wordmark, vertical links, names and room titles (Latin subset)
text: body, navigation, labels, forms and buttons (variable 200-900, Latin subset)

summary.en: A hotel theme for a converted harbour warehouse: a letterbox first screen between two black bars, a vertical essay title over three serif columns, room stills, a parallax night band and a black-paper-black ground that returns the building photograph under the footer.
